chunks.head: set sail
chunks.note: set sail (for …) = 启航前往某地。
chunks.ex_en: Our boat set sail as the sun rose.
chunks.ex_cn: 太阳升起时我们的船起航了。

chunks.head: give over
chunks.note: give over (doing sth) = 停下、不再做某事。
chunks.ex_en: She gave over trying to fix the old phone.
chunks.ex_cn: 她放弃了修那部旧手机。

chunks.head: come ashore
chunks.note: come ashore = 从水上到岸上。
chunks.ex_en: The sailors came ashore to find fresh water.

chunks.head: on shore
chunks.note: on shore = 在陆地上(与在船上/海上相对)。
chunks.ex_en: We stayed on shore while the storm passed.
chunks.ex_cn: 暴风雨过去时我们一直待在岸上。

chunks.head: at a loss
chunks.note: at a loss (what to do / for words) = 一时想不出办法或话。
chunks.ex_en: I was at a loss for what to say.
chunks.ex_cn: 我一时不知道该说什么。

chunks.head: at length
chunks.note: at length(句首)= 经过一段时间后终于。
chunks.ex_en: At length, the rain finally stopped.

chunks.head: in the meantime
chunks.note: in the meantime = 在两件事之间的这段时间里。
chunks.ex_en: Dinner is cooking; in the meantime, let's set the table.
chunks.ex_cn: 饭在做着;这期间我们先摆好桌子吧。

chunks.head: in a word
chunks.note: in a word(句首)= 简言之、概括起来说。
chunks.ex_en: In a word, the trip was perfect.

chunks.head: lay down one's arms
chunks.note: lay down (one's) arms = 缴械投降。
chunks.ex_en: The soldiers laid down their guns and surrendered.

chunks.head: look after
chunks.note: look after = 照看、负责照顾。

literal.note_cn: (此处)与 look 连用表'照看'

chunks.ex_en: Can you look after my dog this weekend?
chunks.ex_cn: 这个周末你能帮我照看一下我的狗吗?

chunks.head: knock down
chunks.note: knock down = 击打或撞使倒下。
chunks.ex_en: The strong wind knocked down the old fence.
chunks.ex_cn: 大风把那道旧栅栏刮倒了。

chunks.head: leave behind
chunks.note: leave behind = 把人或物留在原处、没带走。
chunks.ex_en: Don't leave your umbrella behind at school.
chunks.ex_cn: 别把你的伞落在学校了。

chunks.head: from head to foot
chunks.note: from head to foot = 全身上下、彻头彻尾。
chunks.ex_en: The child was covered in mud from head to foot.
chunks.ex_cn: 那孩子从头到脚沾满了泥。

chunks.head: as good as one's word
chunks.note: be as good as one's word = 兑现承诺。
chunks.ex_en: I promised to help, and I was as good as my word.
chunks.ex_cn: 我答应帮忙,而且我说到做到。

chunks.head: run away with
chunks.note: run away with sth = 私自带走、卷走某物。
chunks.ex_en: The thief tried to run away with her bag.
chunks.ex_cn: 小偷想抢走她的包逃跑。

chunks.head: join in
chunks.note: join in = 加入正在进行的活动。
chunks.ex_en: Everyone sang, so I joined in too.
chunks.ex_cn: 大家都在唱,于是我也跟着唱了起来。

chunks.head: come along
chunks.note: come along = 一同前来、跟上队伍。
chunks.ex_en: Hurry up and come along with us!

chunks.head: put to death
chunks.note: put sb to death = 将某人处决。
chunks.ex_en: In old times, traitors were put to death.
